features: 【WATERPROOF UP TO 30 METERS】 Take your camera on water adventures with the included waterproof case. The case provides protection up to 30M/98FT underwater when properly used. It is suitable for swimming, snorkeling, diving, rafting, kayaking and other water activities.

【WI-FI & EASY SHOOTING MODES】 Built-in Wi-Fi helps you connect the camera with a compatible smartphone for convenient access to your photos and videos. It also comes with useful modes like Time-Lapse, Loop Recording and Burst Photo, giving you more ways to capture your favorite moments.

【WIDE 170° VIEW FOR MORE SCENE】 The 170° wide-angle lens helps you capture a larger area in one shot. You can easily record more of the road, mountains, people and surroundings while travelling, cycling, hiking, trekking or enjoying outdoor adventures.

【USE IT ANYWHERE WITH ACCESSORIES】 This compact action camera is easy to carry and suitable for travel, cycling, biking, hiking, sports and vlogging. The package includes a 900mAh battery, waterproof case, bicycle stand, helmet mounts, multifunction clips, USB cable, AC charger, lens cloth and other useful accessories.

【4K VIDEO RECORDING FOR CLEAR MEMORIES】 AUSEK 4K Action Camera lets you record your travel, bike rides, family trips, sports and outdoor activities in clear and detailed video. It supports 4K at 30FPS, 2.7K at 30FPS and 1080P at 60FPS, so you can choose the video quality as per your needs.
